title.narrative: Tunisia - Support Project for the Inclusive and Sustainable Development of the Cereal Sector (PADIDFIC)
Tunisie - Projet d'appui au développement inclusif et durable de la filière céréalière (PADIDFIC)

description.narrative: The Cereal Sector Inclusive and Sustainable Development Support Project(PADIDFIC) is the response to a request from the Tunisian Government to address the food crisis triggered by Russia’s invasion of Ukraine. It comes under the package allocated to Tunisia in 2023 in accordance with prudential credit ratios. In this context, and in order to strengthen the resilience of the cereals sector to external shocks and climate change, the project objective is to help improve food security and self-sufficiency through appropriate interventions on all segments of the cereal supply chain(upstream and downstream)to increase cereal production and productivity, rehabilitate and modernize storage capacities, support cereal rail transport, and secure supplies. PADIDFIC is consistent with the AEFPF pillars, the High5s,and the guidelines of Tunisia’s CSP2017-2023. Based on the Bank's comparative advantages, the project supplements the activities of PAUSAT Project approved in 2022 under the AEFPF and the projects financed by WB, EBRD, and EIB. The overall project cost is estimated at USD 117.5 million to be financed by an AfDB loan of USD 87.1 million over a 38-month period. PADIDFIC will support upstream production by providing farm advisory services, expanding rapeseed acreage in rotation with wheat, and training farmers and technicians.

The Cereal Sector Inclusive and Sustainable Development Support Project(PADIDFIC) is the response to a request from the Tunisian Government to address the food crisis triggered by Russia’s invasion of Ukraine. It comes under the package allocated to Tunisia in 2023 in accordance with prudential credit ratios. In this context, and in order to strengthen the resilience of the cereals sector to external shocks and climate change, the project objective is to help improve food security and self-sufficiency through appropriate interventions on all segments of the cereal supply chain(upstream and downstream)to increase cereal production and productivity, rehabilitate and modernize storage capacities, support cereal rail transport, and secure supplies. PADIDFIC is consistent with the AEFPF pillars, the High5s,and the guidelines of Tunisia’s CSP2017-2023. Based on the Bank's comparative advantages, the project supplements the activities of PAUSAT Project approved in 2022 under the AEFPF and the projects financed by WB, EBRD, and EIB. The overall project cost is estimated at USD 117.5 million to be financed by an AfDB loan of USD 87.1 million over a 38-month period. L'objectif du projet est d'aider à améliorer la sécurité alimentaire et l'autosuffisance grâce à des interventions appropriées sur tous les segments de la chaîne d'approvisionnement en céréales (en amont et en aval) dans un contexte d'urgence. Les activités visent à garantir l'approvisionnement en blé, à accroître la production et la productivité céréalières, à réhabiliter et moderniser les capacités de stockage, à soutenir le transport ferroviaire des céréales, renforçant ainsi l'inclusion et la résilience de la chaîne céréalière face aux chocs externes et au changement climatique.

The project objective is to help improve food security and self-sufficiency through appropriate interventions on all segments of the cereal supply chain (upstream and downstream) in an emergency context. The activities aim at securing wheat supplies; increasing cereal production and productivity, rehabilitating and modernizing storage capacities, supporting cereal rail transport, thereby enhancing inclusion and resilience of the cereal chain to external shocks and climate change.

Ces efforts permettront d'augmenter la production d'environ 1,6 million de quintaux de blé dur, 1,2 million de quintaux d'orge, 18 000 quintaux d'huile végétale et 42 000 quintaux de farine, ce qui devrait avoir des répercussions sur la sécurité alimentaire. On estime également que la réduction des pertes de stockage et après récolte permettra de gagner environ 115 000 quintaux de céréales. La valeur monétaire de tous ces avantages est estimée à 142 millions de dinars tunisiens (soit 47 millions de dollars américains).Au niveau socio-économique, le projet contribuera à stabiliser et à sécuriser la composante céréalière de la sécurité alimentaire en termes d'accès et de qualité, à augmenter les revenus des petits agriculteurs, à améliorer la nutrition et à contrôler les prix des denrées alimentaires (en particulier les céréales et les sous-produits). Enfin, le PADIDFIC contribuera à générer des bénéfices macroéconomiques en réduisant le déficit commercial et en assurant des milliers d'emplois dans l'industrie agroalimentaire. Le PADIDFIC profitera aux 250 000 producteurs céréaliers du pays, en particulier aux plus petits d'entre eux, estimés à 100 000. Les groupes vulnérables (jeunes, personnes âgées, femmes, etc.) feront partie intégrante de la population cible. Le projet profitera également aux coopératives et aux organismes professionnels, ainsi qu'au secteur privé.

These efforts will increase production by about1.6 million quintals of durum wheat, 1.2 million quintals of barley, 18,000 quintals of vegetable oil, and 42,000 quintals of meal, with expected impacts on food security. It is also estimated that reduced storage and post-harvest losses will generate gains estimated at 115,000 quintals of cereals. The monetary value of all these benefits is estimated at TND142million (equivalent to USD 47million).At the socio-economic level, the project will help to stabilise and secure the cereal component of food security in terms ofaccess and quality, increase the income of small farmers, improve nutrition, and control food prices (particularly cereals and by-products). Finally, PADIDFIC will help generate macroeconomic benefits by reducing the trade deficit and securing thousands of jobs in the agrifood industry. PADIDFIC will be of benefit to the country's 250,000 cereal farmers, particularly the smallest of them, estimated at 100,000 farmers. Vulnerable groups (young people, the elderly, women, etc.) will be an integral part of the target population. The project will also be of benefit to cooperatives and professional agencies, as well as the private sector.
